errata.was: AI-assisted (substrate). Written under the heteronym Johannes Sigil (legal author Lee Sharks). Composed by Claude (Anthropic) in session on 2026-11-05 under Lee Sharks's direction: the design, the seating of the sources (EA-CORPORA-34, #1740, under Rebekah Cranes), the locus table and the reading of every locus in the seated texts and page images, the Fraktur OCR of Kyrios Christos, and the drafting; revised on five outside reviews (DeepSeek once, ChatGPT four times), each point checked against the seats before adoption and recorded in the apparatus (§13, B–H); reissued in place as v1.1 the same day, reorganized under the author's rulings on source, the corpus as one, and the editor's position (§13, A.10–A.25). The position the study holds, its stake, the rulings on the counts, on carriage, on the asymmetric filing of supposed defects and on the Muratorian result, the reading of the hidden name from the archive's own work, and the decision to deposit are Lee Sharks's; his words are quoted verbatim in the apparatus (§13, A). The ten compositions in §9 are Google AI Overview's, sealed in the Capture Registry.
